status: AUTHORED AND MEASURED. Synthetic 20-resume evaluation set covering the 10 PII and proxy categories required by REQ-FR-011 and REQ-FR-057.
dataset_sha_note: SHA-256 of resumes.jsonl as committed. Versions are immutable; if resumes.jsonl changes without a version bump, scripts/verify_pii_set.py fails.
synthetic_note: Every candidate, contact detail, NID, passport number and URL is fictional. Institution and employer names represent real Bangladeshi organisations so NER and proxy rules are evaluated against realistic tokens; no real person's resume is represented.
